title: 16th Finance Commission report for Tax revenue laid in LS
summary: The 16th Finance Commission report for tax revenue devolution between Centre and states for 2026-2031 retained 41% share. Formally constituted Dec 31, 2023 under Arvind Panagariya under Article 280.
